## 6 Numerical Results

We consider the basic stratospheric reaction from the numerical examples presented in Appendix B. The numerical examples are implemented in MATLAB. The simulation starts at noon with the initial concentrations of Table 1 and continues for 72 hours. The computation of G-norms was done with rtol 10-5 and atol 10-3.
